meaning:
robbery, something plundered
Also means: ge.zel (גֵּזֶל "violence" H1499)

renderings.kjv: or in a thing taken away by violence

elsewhere.note: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against Yahweh, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has…
Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is…
“For I, Yahweh, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.
